title: selenicereus stenopterus
intro: Selenicereus stenopterus, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Cereus, is a species of cactus native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep, and lowering blood sugar levels, due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and antidiabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The Night-Blooming Cereus has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues.
